description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-050 Cake & Cake Structure against three official comparator records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites exact stored text; absence from published text is not proof that content is not taught.
method: The NYSC column was assessed independently against COURSE-050's four governed headings. The fourth heading is cited in its original governed form and displayed with the approved catalogue correction. Broad headings do not establish more specific competencies, and coverage is not inferred from programme titles.

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a broader/lower level of activity, is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source.
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
decisions: The Sri Lankan occupational standard and India national curriculum are not presented as delivered programmes.
The Australia FBP30521 Baking qualification is not linked: its cake and gateaux units do not document a substantial cake-decoration pathway.
No competency is inferred from the COURSE-050 title or from an external programme title.
